title: REPELEM Carpet Moth Killer Spray - Large 1L Instant Action Moth Killer & Moth Repellent, Kills Moths at All Life Stages, Non-Staining Professional Strength Carpet Insect Killer, 3 Months Protection
bullet_points: Highly Effective: Unlike Moth Traps, our Moth Spray is formulated for immediate results in the control of Carpet bugs. The triple action formula ensures fast knock-down, allowing instant control over an infestation with no delay.

Non-Staining Solution: Our Carpet Moth treatment is non-staining, allowing easy treatment of carpets, textiles and non-porous hard surfaces around the home. Your go to choice if you're looking for a Moth repellent for wardrobes or a Moth spray for carpets.

Long-Lasting: Containing a powerful insect growth regulator, the Carpet Moth Spray halts reproduction, preventing reinfestatation for up to 3 months. The Large 1L bottle provides plenty of Moth Spray for carpets around your entire home.

Low Toxicity: Whilst utilising a professional strength formulation, our treatment is 99% water-based and HSE approved for home use meaning that you can safely defend your home. Always read and follow the instruction on the label.

Eliminate bugs at all life stages: Our Moth carpet spray effectively targets adults, larvae & eggs & destroys moths at any stage in their lifecycle. Our comprehensive formula makes this product one of the best carpet moth killers on the market and one you can trust to get the job done.
